source.name: Oklahoma City Thunder (nba.com): Thunder, Paycom Announce 15-Year Arena Naming Rights Agreement
source.quote: The Oklahoma City Thunder and Paycom (NYSE: PAYC) today jointly announced an exclusive, 15-year naming rights partnership that will transform the downtown home of the Thunder into Paycom Center.
source.note: The page body is JavaScript-rendered, so scripts/check_sources.py cannot read the quote.

note: Arena naming rights: Paycom Center. Start date unknown: the record said 2026 (the season it was recorded), its source is from 2021-07-27.
